meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude 变成编排者：每个阶段派子代理执行实现、验证、反模式检查和代码质量审查，验证通过后才提交，并在阶段间同步分支。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实一份分阶段实施计划时触发，尤其是 make-plan 生成的那份。

say.text: 按这份计划开始执行第一阶段
say.note: 为每阶段派子代理并要求留下证据

say.text: 验证通过后再提交这一阶段的改动
检查这份计划提到的反模式
say.note: 派出反模式子代理搜索坏模式

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator: it deploys subagents for each phase to implement, verify, check anti-patterns, and review code quality, committing only after verification passes and syncing the branch between phases.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to execute, run, or carry out a phased implementation plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Start executing phase one of this plan
say_en.note: Deploys subagents per phase with evidence

say_en.text: Commit this phase's changes only after verification passes
Check the anti-patterns listed in this plan
